newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends down, supplies ease on seizure.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends down, supplies ease on seizure.

text.p: Indian gold prices ended slightly lower on Monday against early gains on thin supplies after the Bombay Customs seized unauthorised imported gold worth 20 million rupees at the weekend, dealers said.
"Supplies are still thin and the market may bounce back again," one dealer said.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) opened higher at 60,640 rupees against previous closing of 60,450 rupees but fell to close at 60,500 rupees.
Silver on the other hand opened on a quiet note but prices fell as higher supplies of imported silver dragged down prices.
